description: The week's biggest Magic: The Gathering price moves: the cards whose price rose (direction 'up', the default) or fell (direction 'down') the most over the last 7 days, one row per printing and finish, with today's price, the price a week ago, and the change in dollars and percent. Ranked by percent unless by is 'amount'. Cards worth less than minPrice (default $5) both before and after the move are left out, and so are prices that jumped back and forth during the week, which come from a missing vendor price rather than a real move. Narrow it with setCode, rarity, type, format legality or finish.

direction.description: 'up' for the biggest increases (default), 'down' for decreases.

finish.description: Only this finish. Both by default.

format.description: Filter to cards with a legality entry in this format (e.g. 'modern', 'commander').

legality.description: Used with 'format'. Defaults to 'legal' when format is set.

minPrice.description: Ignore cards worth less than this many dollars both before and after the move. Defaults to 5.

type.description: Substring match against card type line (e.g. 'Goblin', 'Instant').

name: get_price_movers
